Akhil Ganti
Toronto, Ontario ● akhilganti7@gmail.com ● www.linkedin.com/in/akhilganti7 ● GitHub
Software Engineering + Ivey AEO Student at Western University
EDUCATION
Western University | London, ON Sept. 2025
School of Applied Sciences, Bachelor of Engineering with Advanced Entry Opportunity (AEO) to the Ivey Business School (Co-op)
Key Accomplishments
● Activities and Societies: Telugu Student Union VP of Finance, Western Formula One Team, Western Investment Club (WIC),
Pre-Business Student Network (PBSN), Case Competitions, Western Scholarship of Distinction
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Payments Analyst May 2026 - Sept. 2026
Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) | Toronto, Ontario | On-site
● Scrutinized and processed over 9000 active claims within the WSIB system, expediting tasks for various teams
● Computational Excel of high-quantity data sets and large documents
● Validated over $1.8M in approved benefit payments to injured workers within the WSIB system, supporting long-term
rehabilitation and financial relief for millions of injured Canadian workers
Software Engineer Feb. 2026 - Present
MomentumMind Research | Mississauga, Ontario | Remote
● Developed and deployed a scalable application using React, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js, implementing CI/CD
workflows in GitHub Actions that cut deployment time by 45% and minimized production errors.
● Designed and shipped a real-time payment system using Stripe Webhooks
Applied ML Researcher Nov. 2025 - Jul. 2025
Algoverse | San Francisco, California | Remote
● Analyze findings of large data sets, upwards of 10,000 data points
● Create, fine-tune, and benchmark models using cloud GPU interfaces, such as Hugging Face and RunPod
● Collaborate and facilitate research meetings to meet deadlines and automate billing updates
Research Intern, Nobel Laureate Eric Betzig’s (Nobel Prize in Chemistry, 2014) Lab Jun. 2024 - Sept. 2024
University of California, Berkeley | Berkeley, California | On-site
● Analyzed petabytes of data from multi-million-dollar microscopes using Python scripts and advanced libraries
● Used advanced apparatus, such as high-technology microscopes, to prepare a microscope for intense data collection of
numerous cancer cells from fish and LLC-PK1 cells
● Nuclei labelling of LLC-PK1 cells using various Python libraries (PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib), ImageJ, and Fiji
● Trained and fine-tuned cell-segmentation models to detect abnormalities within the dataset
PROJECTS
Stock Compass: Full-Stack Financial Analysis Application, GitHub Repository Jul. 2026
● Engineered a full-stack web application for automated stock and portfolio analysis, using React, Python, yFinance API
● Implemented a DCF Valuation model with real-time sensitivity analysis, with parameters set by the user
● Modulated financial metrics dashboard, displaying P/E Ratio, EBITDA, debt-to-equity, ROE, free cash flow, and more
Tech Stack: React, Python, Flask, yfinance, Recharts (data visualization), Vercel, Render
Light Data Logging Unit April 2026
● Improved a costly, pre-existing solution, developing a light sensor that autonomously records data without human input
● Developed a MATLAB program that takes 10+ raw data types from the sensor and uploads them as an XLSX file, and turns
it into interactive visuals for four key variables, incorporating complex data analysis tools for engineers and stakeholders
Published ML Researcher: Co-Author of DecepBench - read here, GitHub Repository Jul. 2025
● Designed a benchmark that uses the DOLOS dataset, a culmination of over 1700+ multimodal inputs (video, audio, text)
● Research published at ACL SiCon 2025 (Vienna, Austria), NeurIPS (San Diego, California), MASC-SLL, and ACL GEM
conferences (<10% acceptance rate), offered to travel internationally to present in front of leading companies, experts
VOLUNTEER EXPERIENCE
Vice President of Finance Nov. 2025 - Present
Telugu Student Union| London, Ontario | On-site
● Core executive board member of a cultural club with over 300 members, backed by Western University
● Perform financial modelling for various events, sponsorships, memberships, and university funding
SKILLS
Technicals: Java, Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), Machine Learning, Jupyter Notebook, CUDA, Bash, Git
Hard Skills: CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape), Data Analytics (Excel, MATLAB), Technical Writing (LaTeX, Overleaf), Literature Review
Soft Skills: Collaboration, Communication, Trilingual in English, French, Telugu
